verdict.rationale: Isaac Lab ships a first-party library of agent skills covering installation, environment creation, RL training and migration, and Isaac ROS provides a dedicated AI agent skill for upgrading ROS 2 nodes. Together these let a user drive key workflows by giving natural-language instructions to an AI agent. The coverage is narrow, though: the skills run through an external coding agent rather than a native natural-language interface, and there is no evidence of natural-language control of Isaac Sim scenes or robots. missing for 10: native natural-language command interface in Isaac Sim, documented depth or examples of the agent skills in use, hands-on or independent corroboration, natural-language coverage beyond Lab setup/training and ROS node migration.
